body.subject: @{variables('Time')}  @{variables('Interest')}

body.Body:
Hello @{variables('First Name')},Congrats on starting your Dream Quest with us!  You should've already recieved an email from us that includes your new Focus Pass Username & Password.  This gives you an account with access to our community inside Micsrosoft 365 (known as the Focus Hive)We have a few Facebook Groups to answer basic questions. You should start or continue training there to understand great enterprise skills and business philosophy. The communities are below:Curiosity Hive - Intro to the Future of Work and STEAM LiteracyNote Hive - Intelligent Guidance using Advanced Notebook Applications

Design Hive - Product Management, Creative Direction, RoadmappingDeveloper Dojo - Training for Application and Business Development


If you want to fast track your path to a career, then we recommend studying our Career Training ManualRegistration is just the first step with us.  You'll now have access to the entire Microsoft toolset and direct access to collaborates inside our Curiosity Community within multiple departments.  Our analytics team tracks your activity and shares this information with multiple industry partners to see if they are interested in bringing you inside their organization.I hope you enjoy your journey with us. Please send any questions into our FB Curiosity Community where someone will assist you.Marisa ItoCommunity ManagerFocus Hivefocushive.com
body.Subject: Hello from Focus Hive

body.messageBody:
Hey @{body('Get_Maha')?['atMention']} and @{body('Get_Abdul')?['atMention']} - we have a new Dreamer! @{coalesce(body('Create_User')?['displayName'], variables('Display Name'))} is interested in the @{variables('Time')} @{variables('Interest')} Program. Go ahead and get @{coalesce(body('Create_User')?['displayName'], variables('Display Name'))} started on their Dream Quest. Invite them to start studying the RevelTek Training Manual or Dream Hub Training and make sure they attend Learning Sessions.


@{body('Curiosity_Coaches_Approval')?['submitActionId']} by @{body('Curiosity_Coaches_Approval')?['responder']?['displayName']} at @{formatDateTime(body('Curiosity_Coaches_Approval')?['responseTime'], 'MMM dd h:mma')}.
